_about: The attacks (grips, strikes, holds) a technique starts from: what they are called, who stands where, which hand takes what, and from which side. Read by src/posing/Attacks.gd, listed in docs/attacks.md. Positions are metres in Tori's frame: x is Tori's LEFT, y up, z forward (Tori faces +z). Hands are offsets from the character's own shoulder in its own frame. A grip's hand meets its target from the side the gripping forearm comes from (palm on the side of a wrist, thumb up), which Staging works out from Uke's shoulder; 'along' is where on the bone (0 its joint, 1 the next), 'curl' how far the fingers close — only a fallback now for a finger that cannot reach round what it holds, since Staging.grab closes each finger onto the thing itself (FingerCurl.curls_onto). Names differ between schools and dojos; the ones marked 'check' are the compiler's best knowledge, not the instructor's — edit them here and the panel, the tool and the document follow. 'skews' lists the angles (degrees) the fingers may run across the bone at, tried in turn; square to it when absent.

katatedori.description: Uke's left hand takes Tori's right wrist (or right takes left): the two stand in mirrored hanmi at about an arm's length, Tori's hand offered forward at the height of the belt, the gripping arm on the outside of it. The thumb goes over the top, the fingers round the inside, the elbow easy and down. In motion Uke comes in from ai hanmi kamae and steps through with the left foot as the hand reaches.

aihanmi_katatedori.description: Uke's right hand takes Tori's right wrist: both in right hanmi, the arms cross. Uke's thumb is on top and his palm faces down over the wrist, so the forearm comes at the wrist from Uke's own side. In motion Uke steps through with the right foot as the hand reaches across.

names.english: both wrists grabbed from the front

ryotedori.description: Uke takes both of Tori's wrists, each hand from the outside with the thumb on top. Tori offers both hands forward at hip-to-waist height; the two stand an arm's length apart, square-ish. In motion both hands reach as Uke steps in.

names.yoshinkan: Katate mochi ryote mochi — check (some dojos say ryote mochi)

morotedori.description: Both of Uke's hands on Tori's right forearm: the left at the wrist from the outside, the right just above it toward the elbow. Uke stands on the outside of the arm, offset well to Tori's right, so both forearms come across it.

katadori.description: Uke's left hand takes a fistful of the gi at the front of Tori's right shoulder, thumb up, the arm nearly straight: the grip pins the shoulder at arm's length. In motion the hand reaches out as Uke steps in.

names.english: both shoulders grabbed from the front

ryokatadori.description: Both of Uke's hands take the gi at the front of Tori's shoulders, thumbs up, square on, the arms a little bent.

munedori.description: Uke's left hand takes a fistful of Tori's lapel at the chest, thumb up, knuckles toward the sternum, the arm nearly straight. In motion the hand reaches out as Uke steps in.

eridori.description: Uke's left hand takes the collar at the side of Tori's neck, thumb up, the arm reaching over the near shoulder.

sodedori.description: Uke's left hand takes a fistful of Tori's right sleeve just above the elbow, from the outside, the arm hanging.

hijidori.description: Uke's left hand round Tori's right forearm just below the elbow, from the outside, the arm half offered.

names.english: shoulder grab and a strike to the head

katadori_menuchi.description: Uke takes Tori's right shoulder with the left hand as in katadori, then raises the right hand over the head to strike shomen. In motion the grab and the raised hand are two moments.

ushiro_ryotedori.description: Uke behind Tori, facing the same way, each hand on the wrist of the same side, thumbs on top, Tori's arms hanging. In motion Uke comes in from the front, takes Tori's right wrist with his right hand, walks round Tori's right side keeping hold, and takes the left wrist from behind.

ushiro_ryokatadori.description: Uke behind Tori, a fistful of gi at the back of each shoulder, thumbs up. In motion Uke comes in from the front and walks round Tori's right side to take hold.

ushiro_eridori.description: Uke behind Tori, the right hand in the collar at the back of the neck. In motion Uke comes in from the front and walks round Tori's right side to take hold.

names.english: choke from behind with one wrist held
names.swedish: strypgrepp bakifrån med grepp om en handled

ushiro_kubishime.description: Uke behind Tori, right up against his back: the right forearm across Tori's throat, the hand holding the gi at Tori's left collar, the left hand holding Tori's left wrist down. In motion Uke walks round Tori's right side to take hold.

names.english: bear hug from behind, over the arms

ushiro_dori.description: Uke comes round behind Tori and wraps both arms round him over his upper arms, the hands meeting in front of Tori's chest and holding on, his chest against Tori's back. The approach goes round Tori's right side as the other attacks from behind do.

names.english: straight strike to the forehead with the hand-blade

shomenuchi.description: Uke cuts straight down the centre line at Tori's forehead with the right hand-blade, stepping through with the right foot into a deep right hanmi; the cut stops a hand's width short of the forehead, the left hand at his own centre. In motion: left hanmi kamae at ma-ai, the right hand raised over the forehead (furikaburi), then the step and the cut.

names.english: diagonal strike to the side of the head

yokomenuchi.description: Uke cuts diagonally at the left side of Tori's head with the right hand-blade, stepping through with the right foot, a little out to his right; the cut stops short of the temple. In motion: kamae, the hand raised up and out to his own right (furikaburi), then the step and the cut.

names.english: straight punch to the solar plexus

chudan_tsuki.description: Mune tsuki: Uke steps through with the right foot into a long, low right hanmi and drives the right fist straight at Tori's solar plexus, the arm straight, the left fist pulled back to the hip. In motion: left hanmi kamae with the right fist at the hip, then the lunge.

jodan_tsuki.description: As chudan tsuki, the fist driven at Tori's face.

tanto_tsuki.description: Chudan tsuki with a tanto in the right hand, blade forward, the thrust stopping at Tori's belly. The left hand stays back at the hip.

mae_geri.description: Uke in left hanmi at ma-ai, the right foot driven forward at Tori's belly, the knee high, the hands up as a guard. Rare in aikido; here for the techniques that answer it.
